title: Compliant datastore request
description: One file per datastore, in paths/compliant-datastore/requests/. The request says what the service is and what the data is; it cannot set encryption, backups, network exposure, logging or tags, which belong to the path.

service.description: Lowercase, hyphen-separated. Must be a valid RDS identifier and match the file name.

environment.description: sandbox is the only value allowed in the MVP.

engine.description: postgres is the only engine in the MVP.

classification.description: Recorded, and never a reason to build anything differently: every datastore gets PHI-grade defaults (ADR-0002). unsure is a judgment case.

data_leaves_meridian.description: Where the data goes. Say no with the string "no" (any case) or the YAML boolean false; both are normalised to "no". Otherwise name the destination in lowercase with hyphens, such as "sms-vendor". Any destination is a judgment case.

oneOf.description: YAML false, meaning the data does not leave Meridian.
"no" in any case, or a destination name.
